ModMetaData.name: RimMT Diagnostics v0.17 - T34A Candidate Fabric
ModMetaData.author: Allen / Rimworld-Project
ModMetaData.description: Optional diagnostics companion for RimMT T34-A. Adds reflection summaries for the T34-A candidate fabric, persistent map fabric and global haul worker path. It does not include the T33-A/T33-B census experiments. Disable this companion when measuring pure production feel; enable it only for attribution/report capture.
